name: D30 Label Printer
author: bborncr
description: Print a label on a Phomemo D30 in a few seconds from the bar, instead of clicking through the phone app. Type, preview, Enter.

barWidget.description: Type a label and print it on a Phomemo D30 without reaching for your phone.
